title: Annual audited statements with extension exception

agreement.pdf.source_wording: The Borrower shall deliver audited annual financial statements within 90 days after each fiscal year end; if the auditor is delayed despite the Borrower's diligent efforts, delivery is extended to 120 days.
agreement.pdf.reporting_deadline: Within 90 days after each fiscal year end
agreement.pdf.deadline_calculation_rule: 120 days after fiscal year end if auditor delay occurs despite diligent efforts
conditions: if the auditor is delayed despite the Borrower's diligent efforts
